title: Cached key-value store
hints: Both constructors must create their maps: `&MemoryStore{data: make(map[string]string)}` and `&CachedStore{backend: backend, cache: make(map[string]string)}`. Add `var _ Store = (*CachedStore)(nil)` to get a compile error if a method is missing.
Every method starts with `if key == "" { return ..., ErrEmptyKey }`. In `MemoryStore.Get`, use comma-ok and return `fmt.Errorf("get %q: %w", key, ErrNotFound)` when the key is missing.

`CachedStore.Get`: `if v, ok := c.cache[key]; ok { c.hits++; return v, nil }`, then `c.misses++`, `v, err := c.backend.Get(key)`; on error `return "", fmt.Errorf("cache: %w", err)`, else `c.cache[key] = v`. `Set` calls the backend first and only then writes the cache; `Delete` does `delete(c.cache, key)` before calling the backend.
